## Battery recycling programs

Sample brief grounded in the listed sources:
- A fictional city pilot adds neighborhood battery collection points and records collection volume weekly. Operators report that clear labels and pickup schedules reduce sorting errors. [1]
- A synthetic research note compares drop-off centers with scheduled pickup. It recommends measuring contamination rates, travel time, and participation before expanding the service. [2]
- A fictional dashboard shows collection counts by week and district. The sample highlights missing data and publishes a data dictionary to explain each field. [3]
- This synthetic guide tells staff to separate damaged batteries, record incidents, and escalate uncertain cases to a trained supervisor. [4]
